# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_REFINE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The sniper_overnight_grinder keeper shows high trade frequency and win rate but low edge_capture on J winner days, indicating the strategy is capturing small moves but missing the large directional moves that drive J's edge. By tightening the entry filter to require stronger level breaks (higher vol_mult, stricter body_min_cents) and adjusting exit parameters to let winners run longer, we aim to increase capture on J winner days while maintaining low losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with vol_mult increased to 1.5 (from 1.3), body_min_cents increased to 0.10 (from 0.05) to ensure only significant breaks with substantial body are taken. min_stars kept at 2. strike_offset kept at 2 (OTM-2). proximity_dollars kept at 1.5. require_break_above_open kept true.

Exit: Adjust profit_lock to arm at +10% (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.10) with trailing stop of 0.10 (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.10) to allow runners to extend. Increase tp1_premium_pct to 0.6 (60%) and tp1_qty_fraction to 0.5 (sell half at TP1) to let more runner remain. Keep premium_stop_pct at -0.08.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass, walk-forward OOS test must show edge_capture > 771 with positive Sharpe, real-fills validation on anchor days must confirm reduced losses on losers and increased capture on winners.

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- The keeper shows signs of overfit (high frequency, low edge_capture). The proposed changes are speculative without validation.

This candidate does not conflict with existing leaderboard entries as it targets the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class, which is not currently on the leaderboard. It may complement existing SNIPER-related candidates if they exist, but none are currently promoted due to OP-16 inapplicability.
